svg.title: Arbiter AI: one event, from evidence to explained decision
svg.desc: A connected vertical flowchart of collection, validation, queueing, context, guardrails, prefilter, optional local reasoning, verdicts, audit and operator review. Direct rule decisions bypass the model. No model output authorizes a device action.
svg.text: From raw evidence to a clear next step
Follow the arrows. Rules take shortcuts. Local AI handles ambiguity.
Turn source-specific records into recoverable evidence.
Collectors retain source checkpoints and original records.
Collection does not call the model or execute a response.
SecurityEvent v1.0: host, time, account, process, network.
Reject invalid fields; retain raw payload; 256 KiB limit.
Deduplicate event IDs; recover interrupted work on restart.
10,000 pending/processing cap; expose pressure and retries.
One priority worker; every 100th claim preserves FIFO progress.
Correlate related records; add asset criticality and history.
Scope-check curated facts; adapt to the stable Event contract.
Use event context and scoped facts; propose a verdict.
Return rationale, evidence and bounded investigation advice.
Validate output; recheck guardrails and confidence.
Model failure or suppression confidence < 0.7 -> escalate.
Write why it is considered benign.
Retain the event and decision history.
Show the reason and supporting evidence.
Uncertainty is explicit; no action implied.
SQLite audit + memory history + JSONL decision trail.
Record tier and available backend/model provenance.
Same-origin API / SSE -> dashboard: trigger, origin, gaps.
Recommended steps + review; device actions need approval.
The model advises. Policy and explicit authority control execution.
Guardrail exception: a narrowly matching standing fact can route to AI review, never directly suppress.
